recommendation.name: V2-CANONICAL-BUDGET-AND-FINALIZATION-CLOSE
recommendation.stopLine: If the next authorized canonical run does not return normally inside 900000ms, or bounded finalization still emits an incomplete trace, preserve FAIL and investigate the specific cost/finalization path without another timeout increase.

requiredContract: Use test, project and retry as one canonical attempt identity and upsert instead of append.
Record runner/test outcome separately from local assertion-evidence status and phase.
Failure or timeout has precedence and cannot be overwritten by a later local PASS from in-flight cleanup.
Skipped or non-main tests do not create canonical main receipt records.
The runner validates one unambiguous terminal canonical record in correctness and benchmark modes; benchmark retains its measured-record requirement.

traceBoundary.supportedInference: The total timeout, continued in-flight cleanup, long context close, a second 30000ms timeout and an unfinalized trace are temporally compatible with a finalization race. The frozen report does not identify the second timeout runnable, so trace-stop causality is not proven.
traceBoundary.futureContract: After the producer and runner exit, a present failure trace must pass EOCD, central-directory and all-entry CRC checks within the finite finalization path. An invalid trace remains TRACE_INCOMPLETE and cannot be repaired into original evidence. A PASS run with retain-on-failure and no trace records NOT_EXPECTED.

redDesign: A static budget contract fails on current 720000ms main and 30000ms default finalization values; GREEN uses finite 900000ms and 60000ms without changing any route, poll, pulse, aim, tolerance or coordinate budget.

A pure receipt test replays Browser23 FAIL then local detailed PASS for the same canonical identity and expects exactly one terminal FAIL record with detailed assertions retained separately. Reverse order must also remain FAIL.
Receipt tests reject missing, malformed or duplicate canonical records and prove a skipped non-main test cannot create a canonical record.
Runner fixture tests require process exit zero plus one terminal PASS receipt; benchmark additionally requires MEASURED. No product/browser process is needed for RED or GREEN.
Failure-trace fixture tests use a tiny valid ZIP and missing-EOCD/CRC-invalid fixtures. A present invalid trace records TRACE_INCOMPLETE and stays failure; no repair and no automatic retry.
Exactly one later root-authorized canonical Browser run validates normal main return, one terminal record, expected trace disposition and unchanged C0-C5/V1/V2/save semantics.
